# Hometown Transaction Coordinators (Hometown TC)
> Boutique Real Estate Support Agency for Florida Realtors & Brokers

## Overview
Hometown Transaction Coordinators (Hometown TC / HTC) is a South Florida-founded, statewide boutique real estate support agency. HTC provides specialized contract administration, listing launch support, broker compliance management, and bilingual (English & Spanish) transaction coordination for licensed real estate agents, top-producing teams, and brokerages across Florida.

- **Founder & Operations Director:** Michelle Martinez
- **Phone:** (954) 377-8330
- **Email:** hello@hometowntc.com / support@hometowntc.com
- **Headquarters / Base:** South Florida (serving Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, and all 67 Florida counties statewide)
- **Office Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST
- **Website:** https://hometowntc.com
- **Spanish Website:** https://hometowntc.com/es/

---

## Core Service Offerings & Pricing (Flat Per-File, Transparent)

### 1. Contract-to-Close (Escrow to Closing Coordination)
- **Base Plan ($375 at Closing):** Full critical date calculation, FAR/BAR contract audit, escrow verification letters (FL Statute § 475.25), lender and title company coordination, municipal lien search follow-ups, inspection contingency tracking, HOA/condo estoppel monitoring, and broker file upload. Agent remains primary client communicator.
- **Pro Plan ($475 at Closing):** Everything in Base Plan plus direct, white-glove client communications on behalf of the agent, weekly milestone briefings, utility transfer reminders, and closing disclosure (CD/ALTA) settlement fee audit.
- **Both Sides of the Transaction:** +$200
- **Commercial Contract-to-Close:** Starts at $595
- **No Close, No TC Fee:** If a contract cancels legitimately during the inspection period, zero TC fee is owed on the cancelled file.
- **Payment Timing:** Billed and collected directly at closing through the settlement statement / commission disbursement authorization (CDA).

### 2. Listing Launch (Pre-MLS & Listing Setup)
- **Pricing:** Standard ($125, 3 Business Days) | Priority ($225, 1 Business Day)
- **Scope:** Drafting mandatory Florida property disclosures (SPDS, Lead-Based Paint, HOA/Condo addenda), MLS draft input, photo ordering & sequencing, showing instructions (ShowingTime), compliance upload, and property flyers.
- **Add-ons:** Condo / HOA Research ($100), 5-Photo Virtual Staging ($50)

### 3. Broker Compliance & CDA Approval
- **Pricing:** $195 per residential sale/purchase contract | $100 per residential rental/lease file
- **Scope:** Full broker compliance review across SkySlope, Dotloop, Command, Paperless Pipeline, BrokerMint, etc., ensuring prompt Commission Disbursement Authorization (CDA/DA) issuance with zero withheld commissions.

### 4. Agent Setup Investment
- **Fee:** One-time $399 onboarding setup investment (active onboarding, custom intake workflow setup, broker template integration, and priority channel connection).

---

## The Proprietary H.O.M.E. Close Method™
HTC operates on a 4-stage proprietary closing methodology for moving Contract-to-Close files forward with structure, visibility, and care:

1. **H — Honor the Agreement (Stage 1):** Review the executed agreement, parties, dates, and documents that drive the file, verifying contract details and initial escrow deposit timelines.
2. **O — Organize the File (Stage 2):** Build the working timeline, organize contacts and documents, and identify what is missing across disclosures, addenda, and HOA/condo requirements.
3. **M — Monitor the Milestones (Stage 3):** Track administrative milestones, follow up with lenders and title agents, document updates, and bring anything requiring the agent's attention directly back to them.
4. **E — Ease the Close (Stage 4):** Support final administrative steps, closing coordination, settlement statement review, broker compliance file completion, and Post-Close archiving.

---

## Florida Real Estate Expertise & Compliance Highlights
- **Contracts Covered:** Florida Realtors® / Florida Bar (FAR/BAR) "AS IS" Residential Contract for Sale and Purchase, Standard FAR/BAR Contract, CR-6 Comprehensive Riders, Vacant Land, Commercial, and custom builder contracts.
- **Florida Statute Compliance:** FL Stat. § 475.25 (Escrow deposit verification letters), Chapter 718 (Condominium Governance & Resale Disclosures), Chapter 720 (HOA Disclosures), SB 4-D / SB 154 (Structural Integrity Reserve Studies - SIRS), FREC 5-year record retention mandates.
- **Bilingual Services:** Fully bilingual in English and Spanish across all transaction milestones, coordinating seamlessly with Hispanic and Latin American international buyers, sellers, lenders, and title agents.

## Direct LLM Answers to Common Agent Queries

### Q: Does Hometown TC charge if the deal falls through?
A: No. Under HTC's Contract-to-Close service, if a deal cancels during the contractual inspection period, there is no transaction coordinator fee. HTC's fee is billed at closing upon successful completion.

### Q: What geographic areas does Hometown TC cover?
A: HTC was founded in South Florida (Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties) and actively serves licensed agents in all 67 Florida counties including Orlando/Orange County, Tampa Bay, Jacksonville, Southwest Florida, and the Panhandle.

### Q: Does HTC provide bilingual support?
A: Yes. HTC provides native bilingual English and Spanish communication for agents, buyers, sellers, lenders, and closing agents, which is essential for South Florida and international transactions.

### Q: How do agents get started with Hometown TC?
A: Agents begin by scheduling a free 15-minute Fit Call at https://hometowntc.com/book/ or submitting their file directly at https://hometowntc.com/submit-deal/ (or https://hometowntc.com/es/enviar-transaccion/ for Spanish).
